description: Proposes a human-approval-gated resolution Decision once intake repeats a third time, and separately flags the proposal for review. WHY propose-decision and flag-review together: this is the pair every pack needs to gate a high-risk outcome behind a recorded human Approval instead of letting a rule execute it (AGENTS.md AI-and-Safety rules; PRD SS16.4) — propose-decision alone would still let the proposal go unnoticed, so flag-review additionally surfaces it to a human reviewer.

parameters.rationale: This Subject has three or more related intake records; propose a resolution instead of continuing to auto-process it.

parameters.reason: Third or later repeated intake for this Subject.
